dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: I feel like I've seen you before... Here for the shooting contest?

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: You've got the hands for a musket. I bet you'll put on a good show.

choices.text: Somewhere you'll remember sooner or later.

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: Then I'm sure it'll come back to me soon enough.

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: Urville's been working really hard lately. He's done so many commissions, found some amazing treasure, and made a lot of money.

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: He says he's going to find me the best doctor there is, so I can get better at remembering things.

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: That's right! Now I remember. You helped us a lot back then. Next time, I won't take so long to recognize you.

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: Maybe not, but now we have.

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: You make me feel really, really good about things. I feel like if I stay with you, something nice will happen.

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: If you ever come to Fontaine, you should visit the Rusty Rudder.

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: I'll make you some Tidalga Conch Brew. I made it a few months ago, and I wrote everything down, so I won't forget how.

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: Yes. I'm going to try really hard.

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: Someone said Urville and I make a great team, so they asked us to represent them. They gave us lots of money, and a book to help us know what to say.

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: So I think entering the contest is a good thing.

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: I haven't used these muskets before, but the idea is the same. Once I'm holding one, I can use it.

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: I just wish it weren't so cold. Even one little breath makes everything fog up...

choices.text: Make sure you get some rest.

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: I will. I sleep ten hours a day.
